title: 5AM MORNING WARFARE DECLARATIONS
text: Father, we thank you. We thank you for the privilege of your presence. We thank you that you do not leave us as orphans, that you do not abandon us to the darkness of this world without equipping us, without arming us, without preparing us for every dimension of the journey. Lord, we are grateful. We are so grateful. And before a word is said, before [music] a line is drawn, we invite the Holy Spirit, the spirit of wisdom and revelation to be our teacher today. Be our teacher. Not just our helper, be our teacher. Speak through these words and let every heart that encounters this ministration be forever changed in the name of Jesus. Somebody say amen. I want to talk to you today about morning warfare declarations. And I know that phrase sounds aggressive. I know it sounds like something reserved for a certain kind of Christian, like something for the people who pray for 6 hours and fast every Monday, [music] but hear me. Hear me carefully. This is not a word for a special class of believers. This is a word for every man and woman who wakes up in a world that is hostile to their destiny. This is a word for everyone who has ever stepped out of bed and felt the weight of resistance even before the day began. This is for you. This is for you today. Let me take you to Psalm 143:8. David, the man after God's own heart, the warrior, the psalmist, the king, the prophet, David writes and he says, "Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning. For in you do I trust. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift my soul to you. Do not move past that scripture too quickly. Do not. Because what David is doing in that verse is establishing a spiritual architecture for how the morning is supposed to begin. He's not waking up and immediately reaching for his phone. He is not waking up and checking his messages. He is not allowing the noise of the world to be the first voice that registers in his spirit. He is saying, "Lord, before anything else speaks to me today, let me hear you. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning." This is important. This is so important. The morning is not just a biological phenomenon. The morning is not simply the rotation of the earth and the rising of the sun. In the spirit realm, the morning carries a frequency. The morning carries a weight. There is something about the early hours that is spiritually significant, and the enemy knows it. The enemy understands that whoever sets the tone for a man's morning has set the tone for that man's day. And if he can fill your morning with anxiety, with dread, with confusion, with the replaying of yesterday's failures and tomorrow's fears, he has already won a significant battle before you have even put on your shoes. Hear me. Before you have even put on your shoes, and this is why David prayed this prayer. Not as a ritual, not as a religious exercise, but as a man who understood the nature of spiritual conflict. David knew what it meant to be surrounded. David knew what it meant to have enemies on every side. David knew what it meant to wake up in a cave, to wake up in a wilderness, to wake up and the circumstances were still terrible. But David also knew something that his enemies did not know, and it is this that the God he served was not passive about his situation. That the God he served was actively [music] working, actively moving, actively ordering steps. And so, David called cultivated the practice of speaking to that God before anything else could speak to him. Now, let me show you something in the book of Job chapter 38 verse 12 and 13. God is speaking to Job out of the whirlwind, and he asked this extraordinary question. He says, "Have you commanded the morning since your days began, and caused the dawn to know its place, that it might take hold of the ends of the earth and shake the wicked out of it?" Did you see that? Did you see what God asked? He said, "Have you commanded the morning? Have you issued instructions to your morning?" Because the implication in that question is that the morning can be commanded. The implication is that there is a divine intention built into every sunrise, and it is the responsibility of a man who knows God to access that intention, to agree with it, to speak it into his day. I'm preaching to somebody right now. I need you to stay with me. You see, most believers are passive in the morning. They are passive. They wake up and they receive whatever the morning brings them. They wake up and they allow the atmosphere to dictate their emotional state. They wake up and they are at the mercy of circumstances, but there is another kind of Christian. There is a believer who understands what Paul was saying in Ephesians chapter 6 when he wrote about the whole armor of God. Paul said, "Wherefore take on to you the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all to stand. Having done all." That phrase means that there is a preparation that must precede the battle, that there is something you do before the arrows fly, that you do not wait until the enemy is at the gate before you begin to arm yourself. You arm yourself before the gate is even tested. And that preparation, that arming, that putting on it happens in the morning. It happens in those quiet hours when the world has not yet made its demands on you. When your mind is still fresh, when your spirit is still open, when the atmosphere is still thin enough for you to pierce through with your words and your worship and your declarations. Morning warfare is not about being aggressive for the sake of aggression. It is about being intentional about your spiritual positioning before you step into the arena of the day. Let me show you one more scripture before we go deeper. Isaiah chapter 50, verse 4. And this is Jesus speaking prophetically through Isaiah. He says, "The Lord God has given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him who is weary. He awakens me morning by morning. He awakens my ear to hear as the learned. He awakens me morning by morning. Jesus, the Son of [music] God, the eternal word made flesh, had a morning practice. Jesus had a morning appointment with the [music] Father. And if the Son of God who was already one with the Father felt it necessary to be awakened morning by morning to receive [music] fresh instruction for each new day, then what does that say about you? What does that say about us? If Jesus needed the morning, you need the morning. If the anointed one set his ear in the morning, you must set your ear in the morning. This is not optional. This is not a suggestion. This is the pattern of heaven being demonstrated through the life of Christ. Father, I want to pause for a moment. I want to pause and just speak to you. Holy Spirit, you are so faithful. You are faithful. Right now, for everyone who is hearing these words, I pray that you open their understanding. I pray that scales fall from their eyes. I pray that the lethargy that has kept them passive in their mornings would be broken right now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of heaviness that makes the morning feel like a burden rather than a blessing, I command it to go right now. I command it to go. Every assignment of the enemy to cloud the mind in the early hours of the day to fill the heart with confusion before prayer can even begin, I break that assignment. I break it. I break it by the blood of Jesus, and I break it by the power of the name that is above every name. Holy Spirit, make their mornings holy again. Make their mornings intentional again. Make their mornings a launching pad for the destiny you have placed in their hands. We receive this, Lord. We receive this in Jesus' name. Somebody say amen. Now, I want to talk to you about what warfare declarations actually are, and I want to be precise here, because there is a lot of confusion around this concept. Some people think declarations are you just shouting things into the air. Some people think it is positive confession in the sense of just saying what you want and hoping it materializes, but hear me. Biblical declarations are rooted [music] in covenant. They are the vocal activation of what God has already decreed. You see, there is a difference between wishing and declaring. When you wish, you are expressing desire without authority. When you declare, you are issuing a statement from a position of delegated authority, the authority that was given to you when Jesus said in Luke chapter 10, "Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy." That authority has a vocal dimension, that authority has a spoken expression. The enemy does not respond to [music] your thoughts. The enemy does not respond to your feelings. The enemy responds to the word of God spoken in faith by a believer who knows who they are. This is important. The word of God is described in Hebrews chapter 4 verse 12 as living and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the division of soul and spirit, of joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart. The word is alive, the word is a weapon. And a weapon that is kept in a drawer cannot protect you. A sword that remains in its sheath cannot cut through anything. The word must be drawn, the word must be spoken. The word must be released from your mouth into the atmosphere of your life, your family, your finances, your health, your ministry, your calling. Every area of your life needs to be covered by the word spoken in faith. I am preaching to somebody today. I am preaching to somebody who has been quiet when they should have been declaring. I am preaching to someone who has been praying generic prayers when God has given them specific promises. I am preaching to someone who knows the word academically but has not learned to weaponize it. Hear me, the word in your head is theology, the word in your mouth is warfare and the morning is when you make the transition from theology to warfare. The morning is when you take everything you know, everything you believe, everything that God has said concerning your life and you speak it, you declare it, you announce it to the heavens, to the earth, to the principalities and powers that have gathered against your destiny. Let me give you some dimensions of morning warfare declarations so that this is practical. >> [music] >> The first dimension is declaration of identity. Before you declare anything about your circumstances, you must first declare who you are because the enemy's primary strategy is not to attack your finances first, his primary strategy is to attack your identity. Because he knows that if he can make you forget who you are, everything else will crumble on its own. If he can make you question your sonship, your authority, your access, your inheritance, he does not even have to touch your circumstances, you will do the destruction yourself. So, every morning, before anything else, you open your mouth and you declare, "I am a child of the most high God. I am born of incorruptible seed. I am sealed by the Holy Spirit. I am justified by the blood of Jesus. I have been given the spirit of adoption whereby I cry, "Abba Father." I am not a servant of sin. I am a servant of righteousness. I am more than a conqueror through him that love me. I am seated [music] in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. These are not motivational statements, these are covenant realities. These are things that are true about you whether you feel them or not. And the act of declaring them every morning is not you trying to convince God. God already knows who you are. The act of declaring them is you reminding yourself, and it is you putting the enemy on notice that you know who you are. Because the moment you know who you are, his strategies become powerless. The second dimension is declaration over your day. Proverbs 16:2-3 says, "Commit your works to the Lord, and your thoughts will be established." Every morning is a blank canvas. Every morning is a new territory. And you have the authority to speak over that territory before you enter it. You can declare that the path of the righteous is a shining light that shines more and more until the perfect day. You can declare that no weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn. You can [music] declare that God causes you to triumph in every place. You can declare that your steps are ordered of the Lord, and he delights in your way. You [music] can declare that angels have been dispatched on your behalf to prepare the way before you. This is not arrogance. This is not presumption. This is what it looks like to be a kingdom citizen who understands the privileges of sonship. The third dimension, and this one is crucial, is declaration of cancellation. There are some things you must cancel in the morning before they have a chance to manifest in your day. The prophet Isaiah records God saying in chapter 54:17, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper." Notice the grammar. It does not say no weapon will be formed. Weapons will be formed. The enemy is strategic. He's diligent. He forms weapons, weapons of destruction, weapons of fear, weapons of delay, weapons of accusation, weapons of sickness, weapons of financial pressure. He forms them. But God's guarantee is not that weapons will not be formed. God's guarantee is that they [music] will not prosper. And there is a role you play in that non-prospery. There is an active component where you rise in the morning and you cancel the assignments, you cancel the weapons, you say, "Every arrow the enemy has released against my life today, it will not find its mark." Every plan of darkness [music] that has been fashioned against my peace, my health, my relationships, my destiny, I cancel it now by the blood of Jesus, by the word of my testimony, by the authority that has been invested in me as a son and daughter of the living God. If someone is listening to this right now and your heart is burning, if you feel something awakening inside you, if there is a stirring in your spirit as though something has been sleeping and is now waking up, I want you to pause right now. I want you to send this word to someone, not because you have to, not because of any obligation, but because you know someone, you know someone who has been waking up defeated, you know someone whose mornings are chaotic, you know someone who is fighting battles in the natural that can only be resolved in the spirit. Send them this word. Let it be your act of intercession for them. Let your sharing of this ministration be your morning declaration over their life, because God can use you as the carrier of someone else's breakthrough. Do not hold this to yourself. Pass it on. Now, I want to shift I want to take us into the prophetic dimension of this word, because God wants to say something specific over the lives of everyone who has ears to hear this today. You have been misreading your warfare. You have been treating it as a sign of weakness, as a sign that something is wrong with you, as evidence that God has forgotten you or that your faith is inadequate. But hear the word of the Lord. The fact that hell has been so aggressive against your life is not a sign that God has abandoned you. It is a sign that heaven has invested so much in you that the enemy cannot afford to leave you alone. You do not fight small battles over small destinies. The level of resistance you have encountered >> [music] >> is a prophetic clue about the level of impact you are about to carry. The warfare was not sent to destroy you, it was sent to distract you, it was sent to drain you. It was sent to make you so weary of fighting that you would lay down your sword and settle for less than your inheritance. But, this is what God says to you today, pick it up. Pick up your sword. Pick up your mouth. Pick up your declarations because the battle has already been decided in the heavenlies and you are on the winning side. I declare over you right now, every delay in your life that was engineered by demonic interference is being reversed. Every door that was shut by the hand of the enemy is being opened by the hand of the Lord. Every promise that seemed like it had died, every dream that was buried, every word that God spoke over your life that the enemy tried to silence, I decree that it is coming back to life. The spirit of God is breathing over your situation right now, the same way he breathed over the void in Genesis and brought order out of chaos. He's breathing over you. He's breathing over your situation. And what comes forth will not be a partial blessing, it will not be a compromise, it will not be a consolation prize, it will be the full manifestation of what God intended before the foundation of the world. I see someone right now, you are in a season where everything feels like it is taking too long. Where you have been faithful, where you have prayed, where you have fasted, where you have obeyed, and yet the visible confirmation has not yet arrived. And the enemy has been using that delay to speak to you. He has been telling you that you misheard God. He has been telling you that the promise is not for you. He has been telling you that others are moving forward while you are standing still. But, hear the word of the Lord. Habakkuk chapter 2 verse 3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time. But, at the end it will speak it will not lie. Though it tarries, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. Do you see what God says? He says, "Though it tarries, though it looks like it is late, it will not tarry. There is a divine punctuality operating in your situation and the enemy cannot shift the appointed time. He can try. He can apply pressure. He can manufacture confusion, but God has set an appointed time for your testimony and that time is locked in eternity and nothing can change it. Now, I need everyone who is with me to receive a different level of intensity because we are moving into intercession. We are moving into warfare prayer and I need your spirit to agree with every word that comes forth. Father, in the name of Jesus, we rise. We rise this morning as warriors. We rise as sons and daughters who know the name they carry. Holy Spirit, be the voice of this intercession. Let every syllable carry divine weight. Let every declaration be enforced by the armies of heaven. We declare right now over every person under the sound and reach of this word, the heavens are open over your life. The heavens are open. We bind every spirit of blockage. We bind every principality [music] that has been assigned to create a ceiling over your progress. We bind the spirit of stagnation. We bind the spirit of confusion. We bind the spirit of double-mindedness. We bind the spirit of fear. We bind them all. We bind them by the name of Jesus, by the blood of Jesus, by the word of our testimony. And we declare that they have no authority, no access, no legal right to operate in the lives of the sons and daughters of God. Be loosed. Be loosed from their grip right now in the name of Jesus. We release revelation. We release clarity. We release divine direction over every mind that has been clouded by the enemy's fog. Father, the word says you are not the author of confusion but of peace. So, we cancel every confusion right now and we release the peace of God that passes all understanding [music] to garrison every heart and mind in Christ Jesus. Receive it. Receive it right now. We speak to finances. We speak to every financial wall, every financial limitation that was erected by demonic hands. We declare that the cattle on a thousand hills belong to the Lord. We declare that God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. We declare that the blessing of the Lord makes rich and adds no sorrow to it. We declare that you shall lend and not borrow, that you shall be the head and not the tail, that you shall be above only and not beneath. Every financial curse is broken right now. Every pattern of lack, every pattern of scarcity, every cycle that has been running in your bloodline that keeps money from finding its way to you, we break it. We break it at the root. [music] We break it in the name of Jesus and we release the anointing for wealth creation. We release the spirit of enterprise and excellence and divine wisdom to know what to do with what God is releasing. We speak to health. We speak to everybody that has been under attack. We declare that by his stripes you are healed. That God sent his word and healed them and delivered them from all their destructions. Every sickness, every infirmity, every diagnosis that contradicts the report of the Lord, we declare it null and void. We declare that the same spirit that raised Christ Jesus from the dead [music] dwells in you and is quickening your mortal body even now. Receive your healing. Receive your healing. Receive your healing in the name of Jesus. We speak to relationships. We speak to every relationship that the enemy has tried to destroy, Every family that has been torn apart by demonic manipulation, every marriage that is under attack, every friendship that carries prophetic significance that the enemy is trying to sever, we declare restoration. We declare the oil of the Holy Spirit is flooding those relationships right now. We declare that what God has joined together no devil has the power to put asunder. We release reconciliation and peace and the love of God into every fractured relationship in the lives of everyone who has engaged [music] this world. We speak to calling and ministry. We speak to every gift that has been [music] dormant. We speak to every anointing that has been buried under shame, under past failure, under the voice of the accuser. We declare that those gifts are coming back to life. We declare that the anointing of the Lord is flowing fresh and new over every servant of God who has been in a season of dryness. We declare that your gift will make room for you. We declare that God is bringing you before [music] great men and great platforms, before audiences that can only be reached through the unique sound of your voice, the unique expression of your gift. You are not replaced. You are not obsolete. You are not forgotten. You are being prepared and the preparation is finishing. The preparation is finishing in the name of Jesus. Father, we cover everyone under the blood of Jesus. We cover their homes, their families, their finances, their health, their ministries, their businesses, their marriages, their children. We cover them with the blood. We cover them and we declare that no evil shall befall them and no plague shall come near their dwelling because they have made the Lord their refuge, because they have made the Most High their habitation. The angels of the Lord are encamped round about them and are delivering them. This is done. This is established. It is settled in heaven and it is settled on earth in the mighty name of Jesus. Somebody shout amen. Let me come back now. Let me close with this charge. The reason most believers are not working in victory is not because God has not given them weapons. It is because they have not learned to use what they have been given. The sword of the spirit, which is the word of God, is in your hands. The name of Jesus, which is above every other name, is in your mouth. The Holy Spirit, who is the spirit of power and love and of a sound mind, is in your spirit. The blood of Jesus, which speaks better things than the blood of Abel, is your covering. You have everything you need for morning warfare. Everything. And so, I want to leave you with a challenge. From this morning, from this very moment, make a decision. Make a decision that you will not give your mornings to passivity. Make a decision that the first words to leave your mouth every morning will not be complaints or confusion or commentary about your circumstances. Make a decision that you will rise, however early, however difficult it feels, and you will speak. You will declare. [music] You will worship. You will invoke the presence of God. You will set the atmosphere. You will commission your angels. >> [music] >> You will cancel the enemy's assignments. You will activate the promises of God. You will speak life over your day before darkness can speak death into it. Because here is what I know. Here is what I have seen. Here is what the word confirms. When a believer rises in the morning with warfare on their lips and worship in their heart, the trajectory of their day changes. The trajectory of their week changes. The trajectory of their life changes. Because you are not just speaking to the atmosphere. You are speaking to the future. You are speaking to the invisible realities that will become visible. You are speaking to the seeds of your destiny and calling them to grow. You are speaking to the mountains in your path and commanding them to become planes. Zechariah chapter 4 verse 7. I love this scripture with everything in me. Who are you, oh great mountain? Before Zerubbabel, you shall become a plain. Before Zerubbabel, before the one who has been [music] chosen, before the one who carries the assignment, the mountain becomes a plain. Not by might, not by power, but by the spirit of the Lord. And the spirit of the Lord is with you. The spirit of the Lord is in you. The spirit of the Lord is for you. And if God be for you, let the enemy himself answer this question, who can be against you? Who can prevail? Who can stand? The answer is no one. No one. Nothing. No weapon. No sickness. No lack. No delay. No assignment of darkness. Nothing shall prevail against the one whom God has chosen and sealed and filled and sent. Rise this morning. Rise every morning. Declare who you are. Declare whose you are. Declare what God has said. Cancel what the enemy has planned. Praise God for what you cannot yet see. And then walk into your day, not as a victim waiting to be attacked, but as a warrior who has already won the battle in the spirit. Walk as one who knows that the Lord of hosts, the commander of the armies of heaven, is your rear guard and your front guard and your strong tower and [music] your exceeding great reward. This is your portion. This is your inheritance. This is your reality as a child of the living God. Do not settle for less. Do not be talked out of it. Do not let the noise of the world convince you that the quiet hours of the morning are not significant. They are the most significant hours of your day. They are the hours that set the pattern. They are the hours when the enemy is defeated before he shows his face. Morning warfare declarations, not a slogan, not a program, a lifestyle, a covenant practice, a holy discipline that will change the story of your life. The Lord bless you. The Lord keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Now and in every morning that he grants you in the mighty name of Jesus. In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen and amen.
